Role Center Guide

Quick guides for common Role Center operations.

1

Invitation & Application Review

Invite a new team member, let them submit the application, and review it from your Role Center.

1

Open your Role Center

Go to My and tap your current role center, such as Manager Center.

2

Select the role and share the invitation link

In Invite Team, choose the role you want to invite. Then tap the copy icon next to Invitation Link and share the link with the invitee.

Use the invitation link for the intended role so the application opens with the correct inviter and role information.
3

Open the invitation link

The invitee opens the link in a browser and taps Open / Download App. If Yaloka is already installed, the app will open and automatically take them to the application page.

4

Complete and submit the application

Fill in Country / Region, Real name, and WhatsApp, then tap Submit.

When the page is opened through an invitation link, information such as the user account, invitation code, and inviter will be filled in automatically.

5

Review the new application

When a new application is submitted, the owner of the invitation code will receive a system message notification.

Open your Role Center, tap Review Apply, and choose Approval or Not pass.

2

Team Management

Open Team Management from your Role Center to view members under different roles and manage them conveniently.

1

Open Team Management

In your Role Center, tap Team Management to enter the team member management page.

2

Switch roles and search members

Use the role tabs at the top to view members under different roles, including Super Admin, BD, Agency, and Host.

You can also search members directly by name or UID.

The page supports role-based browsing and quick member search.
3

Review member cards and weekly team data

Each member card displays the current week's team data and the member's team overview.

Depending on the role, the card may show metrics such as Coins, Diamonds, Active Hosts, Effective Hosts, New Hosts, New Agency, Valid Days, and Valid Hours.

4

Use member actions to manage the team

Each member card provides management actions such as Details, Ban, and Ban Records.

When performing a ban operation, select the ban type, reason, and duration, then tap Confirm.

On the Ban Records page, you can review previous ban records and tap Unban to remove the restriction directly.

3

Salary Bill

Open Salary Bill from the Role Center tools to manage payout methods and review your salary bills.

1

Open Salary Bill

In your Role Center, go to the Tools section and tap Salary Bill.

2

Complete your payout information

Tap the Payment Method area to open the payment method list, then choose a method such as USDT or Bank card or e-wallet.

Enter the required payout information and tap Save to complete your personal payout details.

Complete your payout information before settlement to avoid payout delays.
3

Set your preferred payout method

After a payment method is completed, tap the star icon to mark it as the preferred payout method.

During settlement, the platform will prioritize the starred payment method for payout, except in special cases.

4

Review salary bills

On the Salary Bill page, you can review the total salary bill and tap View Weekly Salary Bill to check detailed weekly salary records.

After salary bills are released, they need to be reviewed and confirmed within the required time limit.

4

Grant VIP & Outfits

Use your weekly benefit quota to grant VIP or outfit benefits to a target user.

1

Open Send Props

Go to your Role Center, scroll to the Tools section, and tap Send Props.

2

Check your weekly quota

Check the remaining VIP quota and Outfit quota, together with the remaining validity time for the current weekly quota.

Switch between the VIP and Outfits tabs depending on what you want to grant.
3

Select the benefit and search the recipient

Select the VIP level or outfit you want to grant, enter the target user's User ID, and tap Search.

4

Verify the user and confirm

After the user information appears, verify the username and User ID. If everything is correct, tap Confirm Grant.

Always verify the recipient information before confirming.
5

Review Info

Open Review Info from the Role Center tools to review member profile information and room information.

1

Open Review Info

In your Role Center, go to the Tools section and tap Review Info.

2

Choose the review type

On the Review page, you can switch between Pending and History, then choose whether to review Profile information or Room information.

This helps you quickly find the review items that need action.
3

Review profile and room information

For Profile reviews, supported items include Avatar, Nickname, and Bio.

For Room reviews, supported items include Cover, Room Name, Announcement, and Background.

Check the submitted content and compare the Before and After information when needed, then tap Approve or Reject.

6

Apply for Host / Agency / BD

Users can proactively submit an application from My page to become a Host, Agency, or BD.

1

Open Apply from My page

Go to My and tap Apply to enter the application page.

2

Select the role you want to apply for

On the Apply page, choose the role you want to apply for, such as Host, Agency, or BD.

3

Fill in your information and invitation code

Fill in the required personal information, including Country / Region, Real name, and WhatsApp.

Then enter the invitation code of the upper-level role you want to join.

4

Verify the inviter and submit

Tap to verify the invitation code. After verification, confirm that the inviter information is correct, then tap Submit to send the application.

The application result will be sent through a system message notification. If the application is not reviewed within 24 hours, it will expire automatically and can be submitted again.

Check the verified inviter information carefully before submitting.
